description: Fetch the full detail of a result returned by `search`, by its id (e.g. "product:<id>"), or of any canonical ref ("zbx:order-line:…", "zbx:settlement:…") found in another tool result. Returns citeable records (document text) for deep-research workflows.

id.description: A result id from `search` ("product:665f...") or a canonical ref ("zbx:…").
